question.text: From amongst the following alcohols the one that would react fastest with conc. $\mathrm{HCl}$ and anhydrous $\mathrm{ZnCl}_2$, is

solution.text:
$3^{\circ}$ alcohols react fastest with $\mathrm{ZnCl}_2 /$ conc. $\mathrm{HCl}$ due to formation of $3^{\circ}$ carbocation and
